completion.action: Nix lifts the lantern; four nested rings settle into distinct colors
completion.copy: The Mode Lantern wakes. One key can hold more than one meaning—and now the Wilds remember how to listen.

completion.action: Vela turns the central compass; four paths align
completion.copy: Vela aligns the Wayfinder. North, south, east, and west settle back into place.

nextHook.copy: The path ends at a page of broken words.

completion.action: Tatter repairs a split channel; luminous ink begins to flow
completion.copy: Tatter opens the Scribe’s Spring. The Wilds can accept new words and reshape old ones again.

nextHook.copy: A sealed gate waits for both an action and a range.

completion.action: Cinder joins two halves of a mechanism; the gate opens
completion.copy: Cinder joins action to range. The Grammar Gate opens, and the first road out of Moonroot is restored.

completion.action: Orin focuses a floating lens; distant points illuminate
completion.copy: Orin focuses the Starneedle. Distant signs and exact characters become visible across the dark.

nextHook.copy: The signal points inward, toward structures hidden in plain sight.

completion.action: Bramble touches the outer arch; nested arches bloom from outside inward
completion.copy: Bramble wakes the Nested Garden. Words, quotes, brackets, and blocks reveal the shapes they contain.

nextHook.copy: Three panes of light rise from the water.

completion.action: Prism aligns three glass panes: ribbon, row, and rectangle
completion.copy: Prism aligns the three panes. Character, line, and block become distinct paths through the same code.

nextHook.copy: Behind the final pane, a sealed archive begins to glow.

completion.action: Mica places a captured crystal into a drawer; several drawers illuminate
completion.copy: Mica reopens the Memory Archive. What is captured can be kept, chosen, and placed where it belongs.

nextHook.copy: One memory points to a beacon far beyond the shelves.

completion.action: Luma sends a thread of light between two distant beacons
completion.copy: Luma reconnects the Far Beacons. The Wilds can cross great distances—and return without losing their place.

nextHook.copy: Beyond the reconnected span, a fogged gallery lens hides the far shore.

completion.action: Luma wipes the lens of the beacon glass; the fog lifts and the far shore resolves
completion.copy: Luma clears the beacon glass. The Wilds can look far ahead, or close at hand, without moving a step.

nextHook.copy: Across the causeway, a stopped clock begins to tick.

completion.action: Tock starts one wheel; its motion propagates through matching wheels
completion.copy: Tock restarts the Echo Clock. A well-shaped change can now travel farther than a single moment.

nextHook.copy: The echo reaches a brass city beneath the ridge.

completion.action: Cinder places two endpoints; a current follows the exact route between them
completion.copy: Cinder sets the Meridian Table. Lines and ranges become routes that the command current can follow.

nextHook.copy: A broken loom is repeating the wrong pattern.

completion.action: Puddle retunes a lens; only matching threads transform
completion.copy: Puddle retunes the Mirror Loom. Patterns can be found, tested, and transformed without touching what does not match.

nextHook.copy: The repaired thread leads into a silent foundry.

completion.action: Tock records one movement into a cylinder; three mechanisms replay it
completion.copy: Tock records the first true echo. The Foundry can repeat a complete sequence without forgetting a step.

nextHook.copy: Only the World Engine remains dark.

completion.action: Cairn connects the restored systems; a steady current reaches all four worlds
completion.copy: Cairn opens the Meridian Engine. Range, pattern, repetition, and judgment move together through every restored road.

nextHook.speaker: Brikk
nextHook.copy: The great systems run again. Bring me the jobs they were never shaped for.

completion.action: Brikk settles four differently shaped jobs into one service kit; a single cyan current tests each assembly in turn
completion.copy: At Menders' Confluence, every restored skill becomes part of one dependable craft.

nextHook.speaker: Brikk
nextHook.copy: The repairs hold. Fen is waiting at the relay, where every route returns and begins again.

completion.action: Fen sends one test current around every return loop; it pauses at the relay, then divides cleanly among the open routes
completion.copy: The Keeper’s Relay remembers through use: return, combine, maintain, and choose again.

nextHook.speaker: Nix
nextHook.copy: The routes are open. Come and see what the Wilds remember.

intro.copy: Long ago, the Wilds answered to a precise language. Every motion had a destination; every change knew its range.
Then an unfinished command crossed the land. Paths shifted, memories scattered, and the great mechanisms fell silent.

intro.speaker: Nix
intro.copy: The language was not lost—only forgotten. Learn it with us, and the Wilds will remember.

ending.title: The Wilds are alive
ending.ariaLabel: The four restored Vim Wilds celebrating together
ending.speaker: Nix
ending.copy: The language is alive. What you restore next is up to you.
